source.post_text: What do you think readers expect from your genre? #writingq #WritingCommunity

replies.text: In romance they mostly want the emotional payoff and chemistry, though I try weaving in enough realism so the happily-ever-after still feels earned rather than automatic.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Same. I don't know how to do it any other way.
replies.author: @epchapman1986

replies.text: Social commentary while I peel back while certain activities are expectations rather than options.
replies.author: @JoeyWingster

replies.text: A little bit of humor, repetition, silliness, and quirkiness.
replies.author: @author_alex

replies.text: I don't stick to one genre and even the individual books are what you might call genre hybrids. I have no desire to cater to convention or expectations.
replies.author: @generatemagic

decoy_rationale: The reply feels slightly too polished and explanatory with its balanced hedge between genre wants and personal approach.
